game.title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
game.blurb: Pirate-themed action brawler set around Honolulu and the seas of Hawaii, from Ryu ga Gotoku Studio, released 2025-02-21. RAWG average playtime: 6 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Washing ashore, finding your crew and the voyage that follows. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Island Showdowns
chapters.summary: The big showdowns at Rokka Island, Atali Island, Flame Heaven and Frost Heaven. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Mad Dog Combat
chapters.summary: Learning abilities, the cutlass boomerang, chain hook and pistol, doppelgangers, dark instruments and rings.

chapters.title: The Goro Pirates and the Goromaru
chapters.summary: Pirate ranks, recruiting crew, Drink Links, bounty missions, ship parts, cannons and naval fights.

chapters.title: The Pirates' Coliseum
chapters.summary: Winning more and more different matches in the Coliseum.

chapters.title: Islands and Treasure
chapters.summary: Exploring different islands and hunting for treasure.

chapters.title: Life in Honolulu
chapters.summary: Substories, Aloha Links, the Photo Rally, clothes, cooking, fishing and bug catching, and the Minato Girls.

chapters.title: Minigames and Pastimes
chapters.summary: Dragon Kart, karaoke, the vocational school, Crazy Delivery, the batting center, pets and more.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 3061810)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Like_a_Dragon:_Pirate_Yakuza_in_Hawaii
Fandom (yakuza.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://yakuza.fandom.com/wiki/Like_a_Dragon:_Pirate_Yakuza_in_Hawaii
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0): only the "Table of Contents" subpage exists; "Walkthrough", "Gameplay", "Controls" and "Achievements and trophies" are linked but not written, so nothing was used. yakuza.fandom.com answers the API, with about 90 linked pages, including "Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii/Chapter 1" to "/Chapter 4", "/Finale", "/Substories" and "/Heat Actions"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Sparrow" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 3061810 as "Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii". 11 of 62 Steam achievements are hidden. Four hidden ones are named after showdowns at places ("Showdown on Rokka Island" and so on), so they get their own spoiler-guarded chapter by name; "Legend of the Coliseum" is hidden but placed with the Coliseum by its name; the other six hidden ones sit in the main story chapter. The story chapters on Fandom were not used to split the story, because no visible achievement names a chapter. The "Obtained all achievements" goal sits in the main story chapter. RAWG lists a playtime of only 6 hours.
